name: Pixal Bitsonia
storyline: Play as a young girl named Pixal, last name Bitsonia, where she runs through the tutorial-focused outskirts of her home region in search of a powerful artifact called the Rom Relic! You see, her world lives inside a handheld console, except, there are certain quirks and bugs that hinder some of the world's regions. Pixal has been guided to find the Rom Relics, and is determined to "save the world", even if she doesn't understand what kind of adventure she's getting into.
